title: Gaussian integration by parts on its integrable domain
source_anchor: Complete source-only-stein.json statement and proof topology.
target_statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\). Fix a function \(f:E\to\mathbb R\) that is Fréchet differentiable everywhere and any direction \(v\in E\). Assume that each of \(f\), \(x\mapsto\langle x,v\rangle f(x)\), and \(x\mapsto Df(x)[v]\) is absolutely integrable under \(\gamma\). Then the weighted value and the directional derivative have the same Gaussian integral. No positive-dimension or unit-direction restriction is imposed.
